script:
set +e; sudo -u azureuser bash -lc 'pip3 install --user --quiet playwright 2>&1 | tail -3; python3 -m playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -5; cat > /tmp/giv_scrape.py << PYEOF
import re, sys, time
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
URL = "https://e.givesmart.com/events/KHN/"
with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True, args=["--no-sandbox"])
    page = browser.new_page()
    page.goto(URL, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=30000)
    page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
    print("=== initial title:", page.title())
    for sel in ["text=BUY TICKETS", "text=Buy Tickets", "a:has-text(\"BUY\")"]:
        try:
            btn = page.locator(sel).first
            if btn.count() > 0:
                print(f"=== clicking selector {sel}")
                btn.click(timeout=5000)
                break
        except Exception as e:
            print("selector", sel, "failed:", e)
    page.wait_for_timeout(5000)
    print("=== url after click:", page.url)
    print("=== page title:", page.title())
    html = page.content()
    open("/tmp/buy.html", "w").write(html)
    print("=== html bytes:", len(html))
    text = re.sub(r"<script[^>]*>.*?</script>", "", html, flags=re.S)
    text = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text)
    chunks = re.findall(r"[^.!?]{0,200}(?:\\$\\s?\\d{1,4}(?:,?\\d{3})*(?:\\.\\d+)?|table of \\d+|seats?|sponsor|ticket)[^.!?]{0,200}", text, flags=re.I)
    seen=set()
    for c in chunks:
        s=c.strip()
        if s and s not in seen:
            seen.add(s); print("-", s[:300])
    print("=== all $ amounts found:", sorted(set(re.findall(r"\\$\\s?\\d{1,4}(?:,?\\d{3})*(?:\\.\\d+)?", text))))
    browser.close()
PYEOF
python3 /tmp/giv_scrape.py 2>&1 | head -100'
